headline: Bill would have barred people born male from playing on girls' and women's school sports teams at federally funded schools.
what_it_does: The bill would have made it a violation of Title IX for schools and colleges that get federal money to let people of the male sex take part in sports programs meant for women or girls. It would have defined sex based on a person's reproductive biology and genetics at birth. The Senate did not move forward with the bill on March 3, 2025.

who_it_affects.group: Transgender girls and women who play school or college sports
who_it_affects.how: They would have been barred from competing on girls' or women's teams at federally funded schools.

who_it_affects.group: Public K-12 schools and colleges that receive federal funding
who_it_affects.how: They would have had to keep people born male out of girls' and women's sports or risk being found in violation of Title IX.
The teams and events they compete in would have been limited to people whose sex at birth was female.
